-- Migration: add reward_band column to customers and backfill it
-- from legacy_code, using the code->tier mapping in codes.csv.

ALTER TABLE customers ADD COLUMN reward_band TEXT;

UPDATE customers
SET reward_band = CASE legacy_code
  WHEN 'A' THEN 'gold'
  WHEN 'B' THEN 'silver'
  WHEN 'C' THEN 'bronze'
END;
